description.narrative: The project is implemented in Zimbabwe. The main outcome areas it contributes to are advancing equality and workers rights building new alliances and pushing progressive politics but also opposing the backlash increasing gender equality. The main rights holders are women in the trade union. Through trainings, seminars, workshops and organising the project aims to achieve progressive development within the outcome areas.Project OrganisationsThe project is a cooperation between ZCTU Zimbabwe Congress of Trade Unions and the Palme Center. The project is implemented with the support of LO and TCO International secretariat. was established in 1981, it has 34 affiliates and organises over 200 000 members, where 38% are women and 23% are youth. ZCTU is represented nationally and has 6 regional centres. LO The Swedish Trade Union Confederation has 14 affiliates that organises 1.5 million members. TCO The Swedish Confederation of Professional Employess has 14 affiliates that organises 1.4 million members.Other Donors to the OrganisationZCTU is also supported by LO Norway, ITUC, Apheda, FOS Belgium and FNV. LO Norway is also part of a Zimbabwe Europe Network which enables for program managers to meet regularly. As is FOS Belgium. The relationship with ITUC is also good.Project Objective1. To strengthen the capacities and skills of women and youths regarding their labour, health and reproductive rights, to demand these rights and enjoy them, 2. To create awareness on gender based violence, the ILO convention and create a sense of responsibility to fight GBV and report cases of violence 3. To understand the causes, types of conflict and develop the capacity to manage conflict and influence attainment of peace and social justice in Zimbabwe. 4. To mainstream Gender and strengthen the capacities of women and youths to participate in decision making in the workplace, unions and in development. 5. To build team work and good leadership skills among women and young workers in trade unions. 6. To strengthen ZCTU capacity to network and collaborate with civic partners on eliminating violence and harassment.
